At 640 g it is noticeably heavier than minimalist nylon belts, which means less bounce-related shifting but more felt weight on the hip. The portable: false rating indicates it is not designed to fold or compress for packing — it ships and stores as a rigid form. A reasonable choice if you prioritize a secure, stable fit over ultralight carry.

short_description: Aluminum-backed reflective gear at 1,091 g with a Midnight finish — portable, durable visibility for low-light sessions.
long_description: Aluminum-backed reflective panels deliver strong retroreflective return for low-light running or cycling, and the Midnight colorway keeps the gear understated in daylight. At just over a kilogram it is heavier than fabric-only reflective vests, which improves panel durability but adds noticeable weight on longer efforts. Portable construction allows it to fold or detach for bag storage between sessions. Best suited to cyclists or commuters who prioritize visibility and longevity over minimal pack weight.

short_description: Lightweight fabric bib holder at 1,036 g; portable and desktop-compatible for race-day organization.
long_description: The RBH-K828S is a fabric race bib holder built for runners who want a lightweight, portable solution they can prep at a desk or pack into a bag. At 1,036 g it is on the heavier side for a fabric accessory, so racers counting every gram may prefer a slimmer option. Its desktop compatibility makes it practical for pre-race number pinning and event-day staging without needing a separate surface.

title: Mosaic Forma Ergonomic Office Chair
short_description: 12-hour mesh chair with dynamic lumbar support, adjustable seat depth, 4D arms and a headrest.
long_description: The Forma Ergonomic is built for long workdays with dynamic lumbar support, adjustable seat depth and a breathable mesh back. Its 4D armrests and 135° synchronized recline let you change position between tasks. The catalog recommends up to 12 hours of daily use and a maximum user weight of 350 lb. Choose it for the headrest and wider recline range; the PostureWorks Pro Mesh has a simpler profile without a headrest.

title: PostureWorks Pro Mesh Ergonomic Chair
short_description: Adjustable mesh task chair for long workdays: lumbar support, 4D arms, adjustable seat depth and no headrest.
long_description: The Pro Mesh is an ergonomic mesh chair for long workdays with adjustable lumbar support. Seat depth and 4D armrests adjust to your position, with recline up to 130°. The catalog recommends up to 10 hours of daily use and a maximum user weight of 300 lb. Its headrest-free profile suits upright desk work; choose the Forma Ergonomic if a headrest or a 12-hour use recommendation matters more.

title: LumaSeat Executive Air Ergonomic Chair
short_description: Mesh-and-fabric executive chair with headrest, 3D arms, adaptive lumbar, and 140° recline for up to 10 hours.
long_description: The Executive Air targets users who want a warmer, more residential aesthetic alongside genuine ergonomic function. The mesh-and-fabric hybrid back combines airflow with a softer look, and adaptive lumbar responds to posture shifts without manual adjustment. The headrest and wide 140° recline angle suit people who take regular breaks in a reclined position. Three-dimensional armrests offer height and pivot but not the fore-aft reach of 4D arms found on competing models—worth noting if shoulder positioning is a priority.

short_description: 4D armrests, adjustable seat depth, and a 135° recline on a mesh frame rated to 400 lb.
long_description: Built for extended desk work, the EOC-C042 Max pairs full 4D armrests and adjustable seat depth with a generous 135-degree recline and a 400 lb weight capacity — making it one of the more accommodating options in this range. The mesh back promotes airflow during long sessions. The trade-off is a fixed lumbar support, so users who need personalized lumbar positioning should consider the adjustable-lumbar alternatives. Catalog recommendation: up to 10 hours daily.

short_description: Adjustable lumbar support and mesh back on a lighter-duty frame; rated to 250 lb with a 120° recline.
long_description: The EOC-R524X Flex is a solid mid-range option for shorter workdays: adjustable lumbar lets you dial in lower-back positioning, and the mesh back keeps airflow comfortable. At a 250 lb weight capacity and 120-degree recline, it is the most limited in this lineup on both counts. Seat depth is fixed, and 2D armrests adjust only height and width — not depth or pivot — so users wanting full arm customization should look at the 3D or 4D models. Catalog recommendation: up to 6 hours daily.

short_description: Dynamic lumbar, 3D armrests, and a 300 lb capacity in a mesh chair with a limited 110° recline.
long_description: The EOC-F424S Tour offers dynamic lumbar — meaning the lumbar zone responds to your movement rather than staying fixed or requiring manual adjustment — alongside 3D armrests that add depth adjustment over 2D models. The 300 lb weight capacity covers most users, and the Forest finish makes it a livelier choice in a home office setting. The clear trade-off is the narrowest recline angle in this lineup at 110 degrees, and seat depth is fixed. Catalog recommendation: up to 8 hours daily.

short_description: Mesh task chair with 3D armrests, adjustable seat depth, dynamic lumbar, 135-degree recline, 400 lb capacity.
long_description: The EOC-S782P suits users who regularly spend extended hours at a desk, with a catalog recommendation of up to 12 hours of daily use. Dynamic lumbar support responds to movement rather than holding a single fixed position, and 3D armrests adjust independently in height, angle, and depth. Seat depth adjustment accommodates different leg lengths. The 135-degree recline adds flexibility during breaks. Mesh upholstery encourages airflow but does not provide the cushioned feel some users prefer for very long sessions.
title: FormDesk EOC-S782P Prime Ergonomic Office Chair

short_description: Mesh task chair with 4D armrests, adjustable lumbar, seat-depth slide, and 400 lb capacity.
long_description: A capable mesh task chair suited to compact home offices, the EOC-V452 pairs 4D armrests and adjustable lumbar with a sliding seat-depth panel so shorter or taller users can dial in their fit. The 135° recline gives moderate lean-back relief, and the 400 lb weight rating broadens its fit range. The catalog recommends up to 10 hours of daily use. The more limited recline angle means it won't fully substitute for a dedicated lounge position during extended breaks.

short_description: Mesh chair with adjustable lumbar, 145° recline, and fixed armrests — rated to 400 lb.
long_description: The EOC-C007S offers the widest recline in this lineup at 145°, making it a good pick for users who frequently lean back between tasks. Adjustable lumbar accommodates different back profiles, and the 400 lb weight capacity matches the EOC-V452. The trade-off is fixed armrests — position and height cannot be altered — and there is no seat-depth adjustment, so users with shorter or longer thighs may find the fit less customizable than competing models. Recommended for up to 8 hours of daily seated use.

short_description: Mesh chair with 4D armrests, adjustable lumbar, sliding seat depth, and 120° recline for a 350 lb limit.
long_description: The EOC-M749 shares the 4D armrests and seat-depth slider of the EOC-V452 but steps down to a 350 lb weight capacity — worth noting for buyers near that threshold. Its 120° recline is the most upright of the three mesh models here, which suits users who prefer a more active, forward-oriented posture and seldom recline fully. Adjustable lumbar remains standard. Catalog recommendation is up to 10 hours daily, though the shallower recline range limits passive rest positions.

short_description: Oatmeal upholstery, a sculpted seat and oak-clad swivel base; height adjusts, while the arms stay fixed.
long_description: The Nest Oak wraps a five-spoke oak-clad steel base and 360-degree swivel in oatmeal woven polyester upholstery, offering a warmer aesthetic than mesh alternatives. Seat height adjusts between 17 and 21 inches, but lumbar support, armrests, and seat depth are all fixed, so fit depends on matching your body dimensions to those presets. At a 250 lb capacity and a 4-hour daily use recommendation, it suits lighter or part-time desk sessions rather than all-day work.
title: Mosaic Nest Oak Upholstered Desk Chair

short_description: Backless fabric rocker stool with 22–32-inch height adjustment, 8° tilt and a 250 lb capacity.
long_description: The AS-V398X is a backless, armless active stool built around a weighted non-slip rocker base that allows up to 8 degrees of tilt, encouraging subtle movement during short sit-stand transitions. The fabric-and-polypropylene seat adjusts from 22 to 32 inches, matching standing desks and counter-height surfaces, and the 13-inch seat diameter accommodates users up to 250 lb. With no backrest, lumbar support, or armrests, it is best used in short sessions; the 2-hour daily recommendation reflects this, and those needing all-day support should consider a full chair instead.
title: SpaceHome AS-V398X Core Active Stool

short_description: 42×27-inch electric desk, 24–50″ height range, built-in cable management, 220 lb load capacity.
long_description: The ESD-M079P covers a 42-inch-wide, 27-inch-deep work surface in Cloud White and travels the full 24–50-inch height range electrically—wide enough to reach both very short and very tall users. Built-in cable management keeps cords tidy during transitions. At 220 lb load capacity it handles multiple monitors comfortably. The trade-off is the absence of memory presets, so you'll dial in your preferred heights manually every time rather than recalling them with a button press.

short_description: 42×27-inch electric desk in Graphite, 24–50″ height range, cable management, 154 lb load limit.
long_description: Sharing the same 42×27-inch footprint and 24–50-inch height range as its sibling desk, the ESD-C473S distinguishes itself with a Graphite finish and a lower 154 lb load capacity—suitable for a single monitor and laptop setup but worth noting if you plan a heavier multi-monitor array. Cable management is built in. Like the ESD-M079P, it has no memory presets, requiring manual height adjustment each time. Choose this model if the colorway fits your space and your load stays light.

short_description: Fixed 55×30-inch desk in Ocean finish with cable management and 154 lb load capacity.
long_description: The FD-M002X offers a generous 55-inch-wide, 30-inch-deep work surface—noticeably wider than the 42-inch standing desks in this range—at a fixed height of approximately 29–30 inches. Built-in cable management keeps the Ocean-finish surface uncluttered. The 154 lb load capacity handles a full monitor and accessory setup. The clear trade-off is the absence of any height adjustment: there is no sit-stand capability, making it best suited to users who already know a standard desk height works for them.

short_description: 60-inch fixed-height corner desk with 355 lb capacity and built-in cable management in a sage finish.
long_description: A generous 60 x 27-inch L-shaped surface makes this a practical choice for a dual-monitor setup or a laptop alongside reference materials. The fixed height sits between 29 and 30 inches, standard for seated work, and the 355 lb load rating handles heavy equipment with ease. Integrated cable management keeps cords off the desktop. Because height is not adjustable, buyers who need sit-stand flexibility should look at the converter options instead.

short_description: Electric sit-stand converter spanning 55 inches wide with 26-inch height travel and two memory presets.
long_description: Placing this 55 x 20-inch converter on an existing desk adds a motorized sit-stand layer with a 24-50-inch height range, enough to accommodate most monitor arms at standing height. Two memory presets let users recall preferred positions without re-measuring. The 355 lb load rating is well above what most multi-monitor arrangements demand. Note that there is no built-in cable management, so loose cords will need a separate solution.

short_description: Fixed-height 42 x 30-inch compact desk with cable management and a 220 lb load rating in forest finish.
long_description: At 42 inches wide and 30 inches deep, this desk fits comfortably in a small room or alcove while still leaving space for a monitor, keyboard, and a few peripherals. The fixed height of 29-30 inches suits standard seated posture, and integrated cable management reduces desktop clutter. The 220 lb load capacity is adequate for typical home-office gear but falls short of heavier workstation builds. Shoppers with multiple large monitors or heavy equipment should consider the 355 lb-rated options instead.

short_description: Manually adjustable drafting table, 55 x 32 inches, 24-50-inch height range with a 154 lb surface rating.
long_description: This 55 x 32-inch drafting table offers a wide 24-50-inch height range, making it usable seated in a low chair or standing at full extension, useful for illustration, technical drawing, or large-format work. Height adjustment is manual with no memory presets. The 154 lb load capacity is appropriate for drawing tools and light equipment but would not suit heavy monitor arrays. There is no built-in cable management, which matters less for drawing work but is worth noting for mixed-use setups.

short_description: 32-inch height-adjustable monitor with VESA compatibility, 94% color gamut, and 45W USB-C charging.
long_description: A 32-inch productivity display built around ergonomic flexibility: the height-adjustable stand and VESA mount support let you position the screen precisely or swap in a third-party arm. The 45W USB-C port handles charging for lighter laptops, though panel type and native resolution are unspecified in this listing, so buyers needing confirmed 4K or a particular panel technology should verify before purchasing.

short_description: 32-inch 4K VA panel at 120Hz with 100W USB-C charging and a height-adjustable, VESA-compatible stand.
long_description: The PM-C273X pairs a 3840x2160 VA panel with a 120Hz refresh rate — useful for smooth scrolling through long documents or light creative work — and a 100W USB-C port that can fully charge most laptops from a single cable. The height-adjustable stand and VESA mount add positioning flexibility. Note that VA panels typically offer narrower viewing angles than IPS alternatives, and the 91% gamut figure references no named color space.

short_description: 34-inch 3440x1440 Mini-LED display with 120Hz refresh and 97% color gamut; stand is fixed-height, no VESA.
long_description: The PM-X586S uses a Mini-LED backlight to deliver deeper contrast across its 3440x1440 ultrawide panel, with a 120Hz refresh rate that keeps motion smooth for both content review and extended reading. The 45W USB-C port covers basic laptop charging. The key trade-off: the stand height is fixed and there is no VESA mount, so repositioning or arm-mounting is not possible — factor that in if ergonomic adjustability matters to your setup.

title: Mosaic Atelier 32 Premium Workspace Display
short_description: 32-inch 4K IPS display, 98% DCI-P3, 90W USB-C with video, pivot and swivel stand; refresh rate is 60Hz.
long_description: The Atelier 32 pairs a 3840x2160 IPS panel covering 98% DCI-P3 with a USB-C port that carries both DisplayPort Alt Mode and 90W laptop charging over one cable. The stand travels 130mm in height and adds swivel and pivot adjustment, while VESA 100x100 compatibility opens arm-mounting options. The key trade-off is the 60Hz refresh rate: well-suited to static document and coding work, but noticeably less fluid than higher-refresh alternatives when scrolling long files or viewing motion-heavy content.

ports: USB-C with DisplayPort Alt Mode and 90W PD

title: HorizonView 38-inch Productivity Display
short_description: 38" curved IPS ultrawide, 3840x1600, 120 Hz, with height adjustment and 100 W USB-C charging.
long_description: Built around a 38-inch curved IPS panel at 3840x1600, this display gives multi-window workflows genuine horizontal room without stacking monitors. The 120 Hz refresh keeps scrolling and window transitions smooth, height adjustment lets you dial in ergonomic position, and 100 W USB-C charging can power a laptop through a single cable — though the cable handles power delivery only, not guaranteed docking or data throughput beyond what your devices negotiate. VESA mounting is supported if you prefer a third-party arm.

short_description: 32-inch 1080p IPS panel at 144Hz with 90W USB-C and VESA mount; stand height is not adjustable.
long_description: The UM-C406X pairs a 32-inch IPS panel with a 1920x1080 resolution and 144Hz refresh rate, prioritising motion smoothness over pixel density. At this screen size, the lower resolution means text and fine detail are less sharp than on higher-resolution alternatives, which is worth weighing for document-heavy work. A 90W USB-C port supports laptop charging, and VESA compatibility suits wall or arm mounting. The fixed-height stand is a practical limitation: users focused on ergonomics will likely need a separate monitor arm. Color gamut coverage is 96%, though no named standard is specified in the product data.
title: FocusStudio UM-C406X Studio Workspace Monitor

short_description: 32" 4K IPS at 144 Hz with 65 W USB-C charging and height-adjustable stand; no VESA mount.
long_description: This 32-inch IPS display pairs a sharp 3840×2160 resolution with a 144 Hz refresh rate, making it comfortable for sustained document work and responsive enough for light creative tasks. The 65 W USB-C port can charge a laptop while you work, and the height-adjustable stand removes the need for a separate arm. Note that VESA mounting is not supported, so the built-in stand is your only positioning option. Color gamut coverage is 98%, though no named gamut standard is specified.
title: WorkErgonomics UM-P525S Studio Workspace Monitor

short_description: 32" 1080p IPS at 165 Hz with 90 W USB-C charging and VESA compatibility; stand height is fixed.
long_description: Running at 165 Hz on a 32-inch IPS panel, this monitor prioritizes smooth on-screen motion over pixel density — the 1920×1080 resolution spreads noticeably across a screen this size, which suits users who prioritize workflow speed over fine detail. The 90 W USB-C port handles laptop charging, and VESA compatibility lets you swap in any third-party arm. The stand height is fixed, so mounting on an arm is the practical route for ergonomic positioning. Color gamut coverage is 96%, with no named standard specified.
title: ModuDesk UM-V272X Prime Workspace Monitor

short_description: 32" 1080p IPS with 100 W USB-C charging, height-adjustable stand, and VESA support; 60 Hz refresh rate.
long_description: Built around everyday document, browser, and collaboration tasks, this 32-inch IPS monitor offers the strongest USB-C charging output in this lineup at 100 W, useful for powering demanding laptops at a shared desk. Height adjustment and VESA compatibility give flexible ergonomic options. The trade-off is a 60 Hz refresh rate and 1920×1080 resolution on a 32-inch panel, which means lower pixel density and no advantage for motion-heavy work. Color gamut coverage is 92%, with no named standard specified.
title: ModuWorks UM-C025 Prime Workspace Monitor

short_description: 32" 4K IPS with 99% color gamut coverage and VESA support; no USB-C charging and 60 Hz refresh rate.
long_description: This 32-inch 4K IPS display prioritizes image fidelity, with 3840×2160 resolution and 99% color gamut coverage (no named standard specified) making it well suited to color-sensitive document and visual work. VESA compatibility enables third-party arm mounting, which matters here because the stand height is fixed. There is no USB-C port at all, so laptop charging must come from a separate source. The 60 Hz refresh rate is standard for productivity use but is not suited to motion-intensive tasks.
title: WorkLab UM-M423S Core Workspace Monitor

short_description: 49" curved 32:9 Mini-LED, 5120x1440 at 100 Hz, height-adjustable stand, and 100 W USB-C.
long_description: Spanning 49 inches in a 32:9 aspect ratio, this curved Mini-LED panel renders 5120x1440 pixels — enough horizontal real estate to run two full documents or applications side by side without a second display. The 100 Hz refresh rate keeps motion smooth for mixed creative and productivity use, and 100 W USB-C lets a compatible laptop charge through a single cable. The 94% color gamut figure references an unspecified gamut standard, so users with strict color-critical requirements should verify the named gamut before purchasing.
title: AxisOffice UM-M725 Studio Ultrawide Monitor

short_description: 32-inch Mini-LED 4K display at 60 Hz with a fixed stand and VESA mounting; no USB-C power delivery.
long_description: This 32-inch Mini-LED monitor resolves 3840x2160 pixels, delivering sharp detail for document work, photo review, and data-heavy layouts on a conventional 16:9 footprint. The 60 Hz refresh rate suits stationary productivity tasks rather than fast motion. The stand height is fixed, so desk and monitor height should be matched before purchase; the VESA mount allows a separate arm to compensate. There is no USB-C power delivery port, so laptop users will need a separate charger.
title: WorkSystems UM-P431S Edge Workspace Monitor

short_description: Full-motion aluminum arm for 17-34" monitors up to 9 kg, with 180° swivel and integrated cable channel.
long_description: Built from aluminum and sized for screens between 17 and 34 inches weighing 2-9 kg, this single arm supports VESA patterns of 75x75 and 100x100 mm and clamps to desks 10-80 mm thick. Full articulation includes tilt from -45° to +90°, 180° swivel, and 360° rotation, making repositioning or screen sharing straightforward. An integrated cable channel keeps cords routed cleanly along the arm. Monitors heavier than 9 kg or outside the stated size range are not supported.
title: StudioForm MA-E217 Studio Monitor Arm
Keysmith MX Quiet Mechanical Wireless Keyboard
short_description: Full-size wireless keyboard with damped tactile switches, backlit keys, and three-device pairing.
long_description: The MX Quiet pairs damped tactile switches with a full-size layout, giving typists satisfying feedback while keeping noise low enough for shared offices and video calls. Wireless connectivity supports up to three paired devices for quick switching between machines. Switches are not hot-swappable, so the switch feel is fixed at purchase — buyers wanting to tune their typing experience should look elsewhere. Linux support sets it apart from some competing quiet keyboards.

title: HushType Studio S Quiet Wireless Keyboard
short_description: Compact full-size wireless keyboard with scissor switches, backlit keys, and ChromeOS support.
long_description: The Studio S uses scissor switches and internal sound damping in a compact full-size footprint, saving desk space without sacrificing a number pad. It pairs with up to three devices across Windows, macOS, and ChromeOS — Linux is not listed among supported platforms. The low-profile scissor mechanism is quieter than mechanical switches but offers less tactile feedback, which suits light typists more than those who prefer a pronounced keystroke.

short_description: Split-layout wireless quiet keyboard with scissor switches and backlit keys.
long_description: The QK-X281P Plus stands apart from standard quiet keyboards with its split layout, which positions each hand at a more natural angle for extended typing sessions. Scissor switches keep noise low in shared spaces, and wireless connectivity with backlit keys suits varied lighting conditions. No multi-device pairing is listed, so users who switch frequently between machines will need a workaround. Switches are not hot-swappable.

short_description: Split wireless keyboard with hot-swappable silent tactile switches; works on macOS and Windows, no backlighting.
long_description: A split-layout wireless keyboard aimed at touch typists who want repositionable halves for a more neutral wrist angle. Hot-swappable sockets let you swap silent tactile switches without soldering, useful if your preferences change. The absence of backlighting keeps the profile slim and battery life extended, but makes this a poor fit for dim-light environments. Note that quiet_typing is rated false despite the silent-tactile switch type, so expect reduced but not near-silent noise at speed.

short_description: Wired right-handed trackball, 4000 DPI, 7 buttons, 131 g, flat-mounted ball at standard desktop angle.
long_description: A wired right-handed trackball with a 4000 DPI resolution ceiling and seven programmable buttons, covering most shortcut needs without a separate keypad. At 131 g it sits firmly on the desk. The ball sits at 0 degrees vertical angle, a flat traditional orientation rather than the angled posture of ergonomic vertical trackballs, so wrist rotation relief is minimal. The wired connection removes any latency or battery concerns for desktop-bound users.

short_description: USB-C drawing tablet, 10x6 in active area, 8192 pressure levels with tilt support, battery-free pen included.
long_description: A mid-size USB-C drawing tablet with a 10x6-inch active area, enough room for detailed illustration without dominating a shared desk. The 8192-level pen pressure and tilt detection suit vector work and digital painting, while the included battery-free pen removes one charging obligation. At 0.72 kg it travels easily between workspaces. The tablet has no built-in display and requires a connected monitor for visual feedback, which may not suit users expecting a screen-integrated drawing surface.

short_description: LED desk lamp, 400 lm, 2700-5000 K tunable color temperature, gooseneck arm, USB-A charging port on base.
long_description: A compact LED desk lamp delivering 400 lumens across a tunable 2700-5000 K color temperature range, shifting from warm ambient light to a cooler daylight tone for focused tasks. The gooseneck arm bends to redirect light precisely, though it lacks a locking joint so it may drift with frequent repositioning. Zero memory presets means brightness and color tone must be set manually each session. A single USB-A port on the weighted base handles device charging without an extra adapter.

short_description: Dimmable 3000 K floor lamp with auto-dimming, CRI 98, and USB charging port in a sand finish.
long_description: The FL-N505X suits a desk or reading nook where warm, accurate color rendering matters—CRI 98 means printed materials and fabric swatches look true to life. Auto-dimming adjusts to ambient changes, and a built-in USB port keeps a device topped up without an extra adapter. At 352 lumens it works well for task lighting in a corner but may feel dim as the sole light source in a larger room.

short_description: Circadian floor lamp with auto-dimming, 1003 lm output, CRI 90, and a cool 6500 K daylight tone.
long_description: The CL-M785S is built for all-day use, shifting intensity automatically as ambient light changes—useful in a home office without reliable natural light. Its 6500 K color temperature mimics midday daylight, which suits sustained focus tasks. CRI 90 renders colors well for most office work, though it falls short of the CRI 95+ range preferred for color-critical tasks. No USB charging port is included.

short_description: High-output 6500 K circadian light at 1483 lm with USB charging port—manual dimming, no auto-dimming.
long_description: The CL-M685S Core delivers the highest lumen output in this circadian range, making it a practical choice for larger rooms or spaces with little natural light. The 6500 K daylight tone supports alertness during work hours. Unlike the CL-M785S, it lacks auto-dimming, so brightness must be adjusted manually throughout the day. CRI 89 is adequate for general office tasks. A USB charging port adds convenience at the lamp base.

title: ClearFrame Studio 4K Conference Webcam
short_description: 4K webcam with 90° FOV, 3-mic array, auto-framing, and privacy shutter over USB-C.
long_description: The Studio 4K is suited to solo or small-group video calls from a desk, delivering 4K resolution across a 90-degree field of view with auto-framing to keep the speaker centered. A three-microphone array with noise reduction helps isolate the speaker's voice from ambient sound. The privacy shutter physically blocks the lens when not in use. No platform approvals are claimed here; USB-C handles data and power but does not imply display output or docking capability.

short_description: 4K webcam with a 6-mic array, built-in noise reduction, and a 78° field of view over USB-A.
long_description: Built for conference rooms and home offices, the CW-P494S captures 4K video through a 78° field of view — wide enough for a solo presenter without distorting room edges. Its six-microphone array with noise reduction helps keep voice pickup clear without a separate speakerphone. Connection is via USB-A only, so USB-C-only machines will need an adapter. Certified for Webex, Teams, and Zoom.

short_description: 40-hour over-ear headset with LDAC codec, multipoint Bluetooth, and IPX4 splash resistance — no ANC.
long_description: The CH-M650P connects to two Bluetooth devices simultaneously and supports the LDAC codec for high-resolution audio streaming, useful when audio quality matters beyond voice calls. Passive isolation from the over-ear fit provides some ambient attenuation, but there is no active noise cancellation. At 40 hours of battery life and IPX4 splash resistance, it suits long workdays and commutes. The foldable build aids portability.

short_description: Over-ear conference headset with LC3 Bluetooth, IP55 dust and water resistance, and 27-hour battery — no ANC.
long_description: The CH-E101P pairs via LC3 Bluetooth or Wireless USB and connects to two devices at once. IP55 rated, it handles dust and moderate water exposure beyond a basic splash guard. Battery runs 27 hours on a charge. At 220 g and without a folding hinge, it is bulkier to pack than foldable rivals — and passive isolation from the over-ear fit is the only noise attenuation on offer, as there is no active noise cancellation.

short_description: IP67-rated wireless in-ear buds, 10 g, with AAC codec and 28 hours total battery across buds and case.
long_description: The AH-A267P is a lightweight in-ear option at 10 g, suited to calls and audio during desk work or travel. AAC codec support keeps Bluetooth audio quality solid on Apple and Android devices, and multipoint pairing holds connections to two sources at once. IP67 waterproofing handles full submersion, a step up from splash-only ratings. There is no active noise cancellation; isolation is passive only. The 28-hour figure reflects combined earbud and charging-case capacity, not a single per-charge runtime.

short_description: Wall-mounted recycled-plastic unit, 24" wide, installs tool-free — fixed, non-modular configuration.
long_description: A wall-mounted drawer unit built from recycled plastic in a 24-inch width, this piece keeps frequently used supplies off the desk surface without occupying floor space. Tool-free installation means no hardware kit required. Because the configuration is fixed and non-modular, it cannot be expanded or reconfigured after mounting — buyers needing a scalable storage system should look elsewhere.

short_description: Modular bamboo drawer unit, 44" wide, freestanding — expands over time but requires tools to assemble.
long_description: At 44 inches wide, this freestanding bamboo unit offers substantially more lateral storage than compact alternatives, and its modular design allows additional sections to be added as needs grow. Bamboo construction gives the sand-finish piece a natural texture that suits warmer office palettes. The trade-off: assembly requires tools, so out-of-box setup takes more time than tool-free competitors. Best suited to offices where long-term configurability matters more than quick installation.

short_description: Steel-and-bamboo desktop organizer, 6 compartments in a 13 x 9" footprint, with a felt-lined base.
long_description: This desktop organizer uses a steel frame with a bamboo-veneer panel to divide workspace clutter into six compartments — sized for pens, notebooks, and small accessories — within a 13-by-9-inch footprint that fits most desk corners without dominating the surface. A felt-lined base prevents surface scratching. The fixed compartment layout suits users with consistent desk routines; those needing adjustable dividers should consider an alternative organizer in this range.

short_description: Ventilated steel under-desk cable tray, 60 cm wide, clamp-mount for desks 15-50 mm thick, 5 kg capacity.
long_description: This powder-coated steel tray mounts beneath a desk via clamp, fitting surfaces 15-50 mm thick, and spans 60 cm wide by 12 cm deep — enough space to bundle and conceal cables, power strips, or small adapters from multiple workstation components. The ventilated base allows airflow around housed items. Load capacity is 5 kg. No power supply is included; this is a passive routing solution only. The Forest colorway suits neutral and dark desk finishes.
title: WorkLiving CM-R414X Tour Cable Management — Forest

short_description: 1.5 m woven polyester sleeve, 25 mm diameter, cut-to-length with 8 reusable ties and 6 adhesive clips included.
long_description: The CM-S866X is a cable sleeve kit for routing and tidying desk or workstation cabling. The 1.5-metre graphite sleeve is 25 mm in diameter and can be cut to any shorter length without fraying, making it adaptable to different run lengths. Eight reusable hook-and-loop ties and six adhesive mounting clips are included for a complete installation. No power supply is included, as this is an organiser rather than a charging product.
title: CraftDesk CM-S866X Flex Cable Management

short_description: Wall-mounted, tool-free recycled-plastic file cabinet, 35 in. wide, with modular expansion.
long_description: The FC-S799X mounts directly to the wall in a Cloud White recycled-plastic shell, keeping floor space clear in smaller offices or apartments. Tool-free assembly means no hardware kit is needed, and the modular design lets you stack or pair additional units over time. At 35 inches wide it suits a full run of letter-size files, though wall load-bearing capacity should be verified before installation, as no floor support is included.

short_description: Adjustable rubber footrest with a 6–12 in. height range and 50 lb weight capacity.
long_description: The F-S230S provides a solid, non-slip rubber surface that holds position during use—useful for seated work where a softer surface might shift. Height adjusts across a 6–12 inch range, giving more vertical travel than many compact competitors, and the 50 lb weight capacity suits typical seated foot loads. The rigid rubber feel offers stable support but less cushioning than foam alternatives; users who prefer a softer, contouring surface should consider a memory-foam option instead.

short_description: Memory foam footrest, adjustable 4–8 inches high, 50 lb capacity.
long_description: The F-S736S raises and supports the feet for users whose chair height leaves them unsupported at standard desk depths. Memory foam conforms under load, and the height adjusts between 4 and 8 inches to suit different chair and desk combinations. The 50 lb weight capacity covers most use cases. Coverage area and tilt angle are not specified, so buyers needing those details should verify before purchasing.
title: AxisLiving F-S736S Air Footrest
Riser HiRise 3 Deluxe Laptop and Phone Stand
short_description: Height-adjustable aluminum stand for 11–17″ laptops with integrated phone shelf and cable management; not foldable.
long_description: The HiRise 3 raises a laptop screen to a more comfortable viewing height while keeping a phone within sight on its dedicated shelf. Built from aluminum in silver, it adjusts to suit different seating or standing positions, handles laptops up to 12 lb, and routes cables out of the way. Because it does not fold flat, it stays on the desk rather than traveling with you — a reasonable trade for a sturdier daily setup.

short_description: Foam anti-fatigue mat, 20 x 36 in, with beveled edges and a 250 lb weight capacity for stand-up desk use.
long_description: This mat is sized for a typical standing-desk footprint and thick enough to cushion prolonged standing on hard floors. Beveled edges reduce trip risk when stepping on and off, and the textured surface resists slipping. At 250 lb capacity it suits most users. One trade-off: polyurethane foam compresses gradually over time, so cushioning will diminish with years of daily use compared to a gel-core alternative.

short_description: Four-display docking station with Ethernet; host connection type and power delivery unspecified.
long_description: The DS-F828X supports up to four simultaneous displays and includes Ethernet, making it suited to desk setups that need a wired network connection alongside a multi-monitor layout. Beyond display count and Ethernet, the host connection type and power delivery capability are not detailed in available specifications. Buyers who require a confirmed USB-C host connection or a specific charging wattage should verify those details before purchasing.

short_description: 8-port USB-C DP Alt Mode dock: dual 4K displays, Gigabit Ethernet, 100 W PD; Windows, Linux, ChromeOS only.
long_description: The DS-N476P connects via USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode, making it suitable for laptops and desktops that expose that protocol on their USB-C port — a requirement buyers should confirm before purchasing. It provides eight ports in total, with HDMI 2.0 and DisplayPort 1.4 outputs supporting up to two displays at 3840x2160 60 Hz when the host supports DP 1.4 with DSC. Gigabit Ethernet and 100 W power delivery round out the feature set. Compatible systems listed are Windows, Linux, and ChromeOS; macOS is not listed.

title: HavenCraft DS-N476P Ultra Docking Station

short_description: Adhesive-mount panel with NRC 0.87 rating, covers 72 sq ft, and contains 90% recycled material.
long_description: Intended for open-plan offices or home studios where speech intelligibility is a recurring distraction, the AP-M854P absorbs a high proportion of incident sound energy across mid and high frequencies, reflected in its 0.87 NRC rating. A single installation can treat up to 72 square feet of wall surface, and the core is made from 90% recycled content. Adhesive mounting keeps installation tool-free, though it limits repositioning once placed.

short_description: Stone-finish acoustic panel covering 75 sq ft, suited to creative studios and shared workspaces.
long_description: The AP-E372X is a wall-mounted acoustic panel finished in Stone, sized to treat up to 75 square feet of room surface. Its neutral tone blends into professional studio and office interiors without competing with artwork or screens. Because this record carries only a coverage specification, shoppers who need confirmed NRC ratings or mounting-method details should compare it against the AP-M854P, which carries a fuller specification set.

short_description: 72-inch clamp-mount desk divider in Charcoal, NRC 0.55, with no cable pass-through.
long_description: The DD-S300 is a fixed-height desk divider spanning 72 inches wide, designed to create visual and partial acoustic separation between adjacent workstations. Its fabric face carries a 0.55 NRC rating, absorbing moderate ambient noise without requiring wall installation — a clamp-on bracket attaches directly to the desk surface. Panel height is fixed at 20 inches, suitable for seated privacy without blocking natural light entirely. There is no cable management channel, so cord routing must be handled separately.

short_description: Graphite automatic drop seal, screw-mount, covers gaps up to 0.75 in., made from 97% recycled material.
long_description: The DS-S762X is an automatic drop seal that lowers a compression strip when the door closes, blocking the undercut gap that allows sound, drafts, and light to pass beneath. It installs via surface-mounted screws on the door face and accommodates floor-to-door gaps up to 0.75 inches. At 97% recycled material content it is among the more sustainable options in this range. It does not address side or top frame gaps, so full acoustic separation typically requires supplemental perimeter sealing.

short_description: Freestanding USB-C sound masker with white, pink, and brown noise, 16 volume steps, and 30/60/90-minute auto-off timers.
long_description: The SMD-R838S Plus sits on a desk or shelf and generates a continuous ambient sound field to reduce speech intelligibility in open or shared workspaces. It offers three noise profiles — white, pink, and brown — with 16 discrete volume steps for fine-tuned adjustment. A built-in timer can switch the unit off after 30, 60, or 90 minutes. Power draws from a USB-C 5 V source. There is no headphone output, so the sound field is always room-facing rather than personal.
title: FormLab SMD-R838S Plus Sound Masking Device

short_description: Three-speed desktop air purifier with true HEPA filtration covers up to 120 sq ft and runs as quietly as 28 dB.
long_description: The DAP-P709 suits a home office desk or nightstand, drawing air through a true HEPA filter that captures particles down to 0.3 microns across up to 120 square feet. A night mode dims the indicator light and drops fan noise to 28 dB on its lowest of three speeds. With a CADR of 55 CFM it clears a small room efficiently, though it is sized for personal zones rather than open-plan spaces. A filter-replacement indicator removes guesswork on maintenance timing.

short_description: Monitors PM2.5, CO2, VOC, temperature, and humidity simultaneously with app sync and audible threshold alerts.
long_description: The AQM-M661S Plus tracks five air-quality parameters in real time on a backlit LCD, storing up to 30 days of readings for trend review via its companion app. Audible and visual alerts trigger when PM2.5 or CO2 exceed user-set thresholds, useful for catching poor ventilation before it becomes noticeable. A 4-hour battery backup keeps monitoring running during power interruptions. The PM2.5 sensor carries the typical plus or minus 15% accuracy of optical laser sensors at this tier, not laboratory-grade precision.

short_description: 12-inch oscillating desk fan with four speeds, a 1-to-4-hour timer, and a low of 38 dB on its quietest setting.
long_description: The DF-R373X Edge moves air across a personal work zone with a 12-inch blade and four speed settings, oscillating up to 75 degrees to cover a wider area without repositioning. A built-in timer runs in one-hour increments up to four hours, convenient for end-of-day shutoff. Tilt adjustment angles airflow for seated or standing positions. At 38 dB on its lowest setting it remains audible in a very quiet room, so users sensitive to background noise may prefer a dedicated silent air circulator.
